history_summary: Ground four Fahmy T4 reference descriptors and retain two complete ambiguity sets.
history_details: Four native reference blocks and two complete ambiguity sets now describe the six existing NCBI descriptors, with six status changes and two native inline events. Keep the six distinct study stocks AZFS3/AZFS5/AZFS15/AZFS18/KZFS4/KZFS11, their partial16S accessions, all source names, notes, conditions, quotations, biological fields and earlier history. Reference populations are not study-stock genome placements or experimental abundances; the retained crosswalk release remains unestablished. The six-stock T4 benchmark remains distinct from the paper's four-stock T1-T3 designs. Predicted functions, HPLC parent removal and native-water context do not establish mineralization or causal mediation. The prior review's three non-GTDB findings and issue1371 salinity, assay-temperature and protocol limitations remain unresolved. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
